dialogues.speaker: Shcherbatov
dialogues.text: Great question! I like talking to smart, cautious people like you — you catch on fast!

dialogues.speaker: Shcherbatov
dialogues.text: First, the connections. My nephew Zotov happens to hold a high position in the Snezhnograd Veche. With that backing us, this deal is guaranteed profit.

dialogues.speaker: Shcherbatov
dialogues.text: As for the method... you've heard of Fontaine's famous "Fonta," right? I've got the Snezhnayan-exclusive upgraded version — the top-secret formula for "Snezhda"!

dialogues.speaker: Shcherbatov
dialogues.text: Unlike that soft, bubbly sweet drink from Fontaine, Snezhda hits different. It's strong. One sip, and your throat will feel like it's been frozen solid!

dialogues.speaker: Shcherbatov
dialogues.text: Everything's ready — equipment, formula, all of it. I've done the math: invest just ten million Mora, and you'll break even within a month. Everything after that is pure profit!

dialogues.speaker: Shcherbatov
dialogues.text: But I'll say this upfront: I'm only taking one partner. A lady named Yurova is already considering it, so if you're interested, you'd better act fast!
